body:
Treat `.diff` and `.patch` files as inert documentation/evidence files in `packages/rails-guard/lib/suppressions.mjs` (`DOC_EXTENSIONS`) so `findSuppressions` does not flag `skip-call` or other suppression markers quoted in committed diff/patch evidence.

Acceptance criteria:
1. `DOC_EXTENSIONS` in `packages/rails-guard/lib/suppressions.mjs` includes `.diff` and `.patch` (case-insensitive via `isDocFile`), so `findSuppressions` returns `[]` for `.diff` and `.patch` paths while still scanning `.diff.mjs` / `.patch.ts` / `.test.mjs` code files. Verify: `node --test packages/rails-guard/test/suppressions.test.mjs`
title: Ignore suppression markers inside .diff and .patch files in rails-guard (#1237)
